BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE i18n RENAME COLUMN id TO legacy_uuid;
ALTER TABLE i18n ADD COLUMN id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        legacy_uuid,
        CASE
            WHEN btrim(language::text) = 'en' THEN 1
            WHEN btrim(language::text) = 'ru' THEN 2
            ELSE 100 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY btrim(language::text), legacy_uuid)
        END AS new_id
    FROM i18n
)
UPDATE i18n
SET id = ranked.new_id
FROM ranked
WHERE i18n.legacy_uuid = ranked.legacy_uuid;

ALTER TABLE i18n ALTER COLUMN id SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE i18n ADD CONSTRAINT i18n_id_key UNIQUE (id);

ALTER TABLE tag RENAME COLUMN id TO legacy_uuid;
ALTER TABLE tag ADD COLUMN id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        legacy_uuid,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY slug, name, legacy_uuid) AS new_id
    FROM tag
)
UPDATE tag
SET id = ranked.new_id
FROM ranked
WHERE tag.legacy_uuid = ranked.legacy_uuid;

ALTER TABLE tag ALTER COLUMN id SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE tag ADD CONSTRAINT tag_id_key UNIQUE (id);

ALTER TABLE tech RENAME COLUMN id TO legacy_uuid;
ALTER TABLE tech ADD COLUMN id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        legacy_uuid,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY label, legacy_uuid) AS new_id
    FROM tech
)
UPDATE tech
SET id = ranked.new_id
FROM ranked
WHERE tech.legacy_uuid = ranked.legacy_uuid;

ALTER TABLE tech ALTER COLUMN id SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE tech ADD CONSTRAINT tech_id_key UNIQUE (id);

ALTER TABLE tech_version RENAME COLUMN id TO legacy_uuid;
ALTER TABLE tech_version ADD COLUMN id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        legacy_uuid,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY version, legacy_uuid) AS new_id
    FROM tech_version
)
UPDATE tech_version
SET id = ranked.new_id
FROM ranked
WHERE tech_version.legacy_uuid = ranked.legacy_uuid;

ALTER TABLE tech_version ALTER COLUMN id SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE tech_version ADD CONSTRAINT tech_version_id_key UNIQUE (id);

ALTER TABLE tech_version ADD COLUMN tech_id_int integer;

UPDATE tech_version tv
SET tech_id_int = t.id
FROM tech t
WHERE tv.tech_id = t.legacy_uuid;

ALTER TABLE tech_version ALTER COLUMN tech_id_int SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE tech_version DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS tech_version_tech_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE tech_version DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS tech_version_tech_id_version_key;
ALTER TABLE tech_version DROP COLUMN tech_id;
ALTER TABLE tech_version RENAME COLUMN tech_id_int TO tech_id;
ALTER TABLE tech_version
    ADD CONSTRAINT tech_version_tech_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (tech_id) REFERENCES tech(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
ALTER TABLE tech_version
    ADD CONSTRAINT tech_version_tech_id_version_key
    UNIQUE (tech_id, version);

ALTER TABLE course ADD COLUMN main_tech_id_int integer;

UPDATE course c
SET main_tech_id_int = t.id
FROM tech t
WHERE c.main_tech_id = t.legacy_uuid;

ALTER TABLE course DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_course_main_tech;
ALTER TABLE course DROP COLUMN main_tech_id;
ALTER TABLE course RENAME COLUMN main_tech_id_int TO main_tech_id;
ALTER TABLE course
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_course_main_tech
    FOREIGN KEY (main_tech_id) REFERENCES tech(id);

ALTER TABLE course_tech ADD COLUMN tech_id_int integer;

UPDATE course_tech ct
SET tech_id_int = t.id
FROM tech t
WHERE ct.tech_id = t.legacy_uuid;

ALTER TABLE course_tech ALTER COLUMN tech_id_int SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE course_tech DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS course_tech_pkey;
ALTER TABLE course_tech DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS course_tech_tech_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE course_tech DROP COLUMN tech_id;
ALTER TABLE course_tech RENAME COLUMN tech_id_int TO tech_id;
ALTER TABLE course_tech
    ADD CONSTRAINT course_tech_tech_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (tech_id) REFERENCES tech(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
ALTER TABLE course_tech ADD PRIMARY KEY (course_id, tech_id);

ALTER TABLE compose_config_tech ADD COLUMN tech_id_int integer;

UPDATE compose_config_tech cct
SET tech_id_int = t.id
FROM tech t
WHERE cct.tech_id = t.legacy_uuid;

ALTER TABLE compose_config_tech ALTER COLUMN tech_id_int SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE compose_config_tech DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS compose_config_tech_pkey;
ALTER TABLE compose_config_tech DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS compose_config_tech_tech_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE compose_config_tech DROP COLUMN tech_id;
ALTER TABLE compose_config_tech RENAME COLUMN tech_id_int TO tech_id;
ALTER TABLE compose_config_tech
    ADD CONSTRAINT compose_config_tech_tech_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (tech_id) REFERENCES tech(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
ALTER TABLE compose_config_tech ADD PRIMARY KEY (compose_config_id, tech_id);

ALTER TABLE course_tag ADD COLUMN tag_id_int integer;

UPDATE course_tag ct
SET tag_id_int = t.id
FROM tag t
WHERE ct.tag_id = t.legacy_uuid;

ALTER TABLE course_tag ALTER COLUMN tag_id_int SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE course_tag DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS course_tag_pkey;
ALTER TABLE course_tag DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS course_tag_tag_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE course_tag DROP COLUMN tag_id;
ALTER TABLE course_tag RENAME COLUMN tag_id_int TO tag_id;
ALTER TABLE course_tag
    ADD CONSTRAINT course_tag_tag_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES tag(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
ALTER TABLE course_tag ADD PRIMARY KEY (course_id, tag_id);

ALTER TABLE lesson_tag ADD COLUMN tag_id_int integer;

UPDATE lesson_tag lt
SET tag_id_int = t.id
FROM tag t
WHERE lt.tag_id = t.legacy_uuid;

ALTER TABLE lesson_tag ALTER COLUMN tag_id_int SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE lesson_tag DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS lesson_tag_pkey;
ALTER TABLE lesson_tag DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS lesson_tag_tag_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE lesson_tag DROP COLUMN tag_id;
ALTER TABLE lesson_tag RENAME COLUMN tag_id_int TO tag_id;
ALTER TABLE lesson_tag
    ADD CONSTRAINT lesson_tag_tag_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES tag(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
ALTER TABLE lesson_tag ADD PRIMARY KEY (lesson_id, tag_id);

ALTER TABLE course_version ADD COLUMN tech_version_id_int integer;

UPDATE course_version cv
SET tech_version_id_int = tv.id
FROM tech_version tv
WHERE cv.tech_version_id = tv.legacy_uuid;

ALTER TABLE course_version DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_course_version_tech_version;
ALTER TABLE course_version DROP COLUMN tech_version_id;
ALTER TABLE course_version RENAME COLUMN tech_version_id_int TO tech_version_id;
ALTER TABLE course_version
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_course_version_tech_version
    FOREIGN KEY (tech_version_id) REFERENCES tech_version(id);

ALTER TABLE course_version_i18n ADD COLUMN i18n_id_int integer;

UPDATE course_version_i18n cvi
SET i18n_id_int = i.id
FROM i18n i
WHERE cvi.i18n_id = i.legacy_uuid;

ALTER TABLE course_version_i18n ALTER COLUMN i18n_id_int SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE course_version_i18n DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS course_version_i18n_pkey;
ALTER TABLE course_version_i18n DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS course_version_i18n_i18n_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE course_version_i18n DROP COLUMN i18n_id;
ALTER TABLE course_version_i18n RENAME COLUMN i18n_id_int TO i18n_id;
ALTER TABLE course_version_i18n
    ADD CONSTRAINT course_version_i18n_i18n_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (i18n_id) REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
ALTER TABLE course_version_i18n ADD PRIMARY KEY (course_version_id, i18n_id);

ALTER TABLE lesson_i18n ADD COLUMN i18n_id_int integer;

UPDATE lesson_i18n li
SET i18n_id_int = i.id
FROM i18n i
WHERE li.i18n_id = i.legacy_uuid;

ALTER TABLE lesson_i18n ALTER COLUMN i18n_id_int SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE lesson_i18n DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS lesson_i18n_pkey;
ALTER TABLE lesson_i18n DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS lesson_i18n_i18n_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE lesson_i18n DROP COLUMN i18n_id;
ALTER TABLE lesson_i18n RENAME COLUMN i18n_id_int TO i18n_id;
ALTER TABLE lesson_i18n
    ADD CONSTRAINT lesson_i18n_i18n_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (i18n_id) REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
ALTER TABLE lesson_i18n ADD PRIMARY KEY (lesson_id, i18n_id);

ALTER TABLE task_i18n ADD COLUMN i18n_id_int integer;

UPDATE task_i18n ti
SET i18n_id_int = i.id
FROM i18n i
WHERE ti.i18n_id = i.legacy_uuid;

ALTER TABLE task_i18n ALTER COLUMN i18n_id_int SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE task_i18n DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS task_i18n_pkey;
ALTER TABLE task_i18n DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS task_i18n_i18n_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE task_i18n DROP COLUMN i18n_id;
ALTER TABLE task_i18n RENAME COLUMN i18n_id_int TO i18n_id;
ALTER TABLE task_i18n
    ADD CONSTRAINT task_i18n_i18n_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (i18n_id) REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
ALTER TABLE task_i18n ADD PRIMARY KEY (task_id, i18n_id);

ALTER TABLE task_test_i18n ADD COLUMN i18n_id_int integer;

UPDATE task_test_i18n tti
SET i18n_id_int = i.id
FROM i18n i
WHERE tti.i18n_id = i.legacy_uuid;

ALTER TABLE task_test_i18n ALTER COLUMN i18n_id_int SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE task_test_i18n DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS task_test_i18n_pkey;
ALTER TABLE task_test_i18n DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS task_test_i18n_i18n_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE task_test_i18n DROP COLUMN i18n_id;
ALTER TABLE task_test_i18n RENAME COLUMN i18n_id_int TO i18n_id;
ALTER TABLE task_test_i18n
    ADD CONSTRAINT task_test_i18n_i18n_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (i18n_id) REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
ALTER TABLE task_test_i18n ADD PRIMARY KEY (task_test_id, i18n_id);

ALTER TABLE task_test_variant_i18n ADD COLUMN i18n_id_int integer;

UPDATE task_test_variant_i18n ttvi
SET i18n_id_int = i.id
FROM i18n i
WHERE ttvi.i18n_id = i.legacy_uuid;

ALTER TABLE task_test_variant_i18n ALTER COLUMN i18n_id_int SET NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE task_test_variant_i18n DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS task_test_variant_i18n_pkey;
ALTER TABLE task_test_variant_i18n DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS task_test_variant_i18n_i18n_id_fkey;
ALTER TABLE task_test_variant_i18n DROP COLUMN i18n_id;
ALTER TABLE task_test_variant_i18n RENAME COLUMN i18n_id_int TO i18n_id;
ALTER TABLE task_test_variant_i18n
    ADD CONSTRAINT task_test_variant_i18n_i18n_id_fkey
    FOREIGN KEY (i18n_id) REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
ALTER TABLE task_test_variant_i18n ADD PRIMARY KEY (task_test_variant_id, i18n_id);

ALTER TABLE i18n DROP CONSTRAINT i18n_pkey;
ALTER TABLE i18n ADD CONSTRAINT i18n_legacy_uuid_key UNIQUE (legacy_uuid);
ALTER TABLE i18n ADD CONSTRAINT i18n_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id);
ALTER TABLE i18n ALTER COLUMN legacy_uuid DROP NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE tag DROP CONSTRAINT tag_pkey;
ALTER TABLE tag ADD CONSTRAINT tag_legacy_uuid_key UNIQUE (legacy_uuid);
ALTER TABLE tag ADD CONSTRAINT tag_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id);
ALTER TABLE tag ALTER COLUMN legacy_uuid DROP NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE tech DROP CONSTRAINT tech_pkey;
ALTER TABLE tech ADD CONSTRAINT tech_legacy_uuid_key UNIQUE (legacy_uuid);
ALTER TABLE tech ADD CONSTRAINT tech_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id);
ALTER TABLE tech ALTER COLUMN legacy_uuid DROP NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE tech_version DROP CONSTRAINT tech_version_pkey;
ALTER TABLE tech_version ADD CONSTRAINT tech_version_legacy_uuid_key UNIQUE (legacy_uuid);
ALTER TABLE tech_version ADD CONSTRAINT tech_version_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id);
ALTER TABLE tech_version ALTER COLUMN legacy_uuid DROP NOT NULL;

SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('i18n', 'id'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM i18n), 1), true);
SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('tag', 'id'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM tag), 1), true);
SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('tech', 'id'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM tech), 1), true);
SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('tech_version', 'id'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM tech_version), 1), true);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_main_tech_id ON course(main_tech_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_version_i18n_course_version_id ON course_version_i18n(course_version_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_version_i18n_i18n_id ON course_version_i18n(i18n_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_tech_course_id ON course_tech(course_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_tech_tech_id ON course_tech(tech_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_compose_config_tech_compose_config_id ON compose_config_tech(compose_config_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_compose_config_tech_tech_id ON compose_config_tech(tech_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_version_tech_version_id ON course_version(tech_version_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_version_tech_id ON tech_version(tech_id);

COMMIT;
